title: The thief at the market
summary: Somebody is taking fruit from Mrs Ruiz's stall every Saturday, and nobody ever sees them.
paragraphs: Every Saturday, for three weeks, something {{disappeared}} from Mrs Ruiz's fruit stall. First it was four peaches. The next week, a bunch of grapes. The third Saturday, a whole melon. Nobody saw anything, and Mrs Ruiz began to look at her customers with {{suspicion}}.

Her grandson Pablo, who was twelve and read a lot of detective stories, offered to help. "Every thief makes a mistake," he said seriously. He drew a map of the market and wrote down who passed the stall and when. He also noticed that the fruit always disappeared between eleven and twelve, when the market was busiest.

The fourth Saturday, Pablo hid behind some boxes with a notebook and a sandwich. At twenty past eleven, nothing happened. At half past eleven, nothing. Then, at a quarter to twelve, he saw a small brown shape run along the top of the wall behind the stall. It stopped, looked around and jumped down onto the boxes of peaches.

It was a monkey. Later they learnt that it belonged to a man who lived above the bakery. It had learnt to open the window of his flat, and every Saturday it went out for a {{snack}} while he was at work. The man was very {{embarrassed}}. He apologised, paid Mrs Ruiz for all the fruit and promised to fix the window.

Mrs Ruiz gave Pablo a basket of peaches as a reward. "You were right," she told him. "The thief made a mistake." "Yes," said Pablo. "It always came back to the same place. Thieves do that, even the ones with tails."

disappeared.meaning: went away so that nobody could see or find it

suspicion.meaning: a feeling that someone has done something wrong

snack.meaning: a small amount of food eaten between meals

embarrassed.meaning: feeling silly or ashamed in front of other people

questions.question: What did Pablo notice before he hid?
options: The thief always wore a brown coat.
The fruit disappeared between eleven and twelve.
A customer had a big empty bag.
questions.explanation: He noticed that the fruit always disappeared between eleven and twelve.

questions.question: Who was taking the fruit?
options: A monkey that escaped through a window
questions.explanation: He saw a small brown shape on the wall: it was a monkey.

questions.question: What did the owner of the monkey do?
options: He apologised, paid for the fruit and promised to fix the window.
He gave the monkey to a zoo.
questions.explanation: The man apologised, paid Mrs Ruiz for all the fruit and promised to fix the window.

questions.question: According to Pablo, what mistake did the thief make?
options: It always came back to the same place.
questions.explanation: Pablo said the thief always came back to the same place.
